description: This source file defines a static generic factory class for creating or retrieving instances of a serializer that implement the IMemoryMessageBodySerializer interface, using dependency injection and lazy initialization.

classes.name: MemoryMessageBodySerializerFactory<TSerializer>
classes.description: A static generic factory class that provides instances of TSerializer, either through dependency injection or by creating a new instance via a cached factory.

methods.name: GetOrCreateSerializer
methods.description: Retrieves an existing serializer from the service provider or creates a new one if not available.
